shortBulletSummary: Crypto market sentiment is "Extreme Fear" with a score of 4, indicating a bearish outlook.
Bitcoin dropped below $60K, now down approximately 50% from its all-time high.
Ethereum plunged, with over $500 million in leveraged ETH longs liquidated.
Geopolitical tensions and significant Bitcoin ETF outflows are fueling the market decline.
MicroStrategy sold 32 BTC for ~$2.5M, marking its first sale in four years.
